description_en: The ExportDoNotCallNumbers operation exports a filtered list of do-not-call numbers from a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ExportDoNotCallNumbers导出指定实例下指定搜索条件过滤后的禁止外呼号码列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc export-do-not-call-numbers --instance-id ccc-test --search-pattern RemarkA --scope INSTANCE --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExportDoNotCallNumbers

parameters.description_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search of phone numbers or remarks. If this parameter is left empty, no keyword-based filtering is applied.
parameters.description_zh: 根据号码或者备注进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤。
parameters.help_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search of phone numbers or remarks. If this parameter is left empty, no keyword-based filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 根据号码或者备注进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: search_pattern

parameters.description_en: Specifies the scope of the do-not-call numbers. A value of SYSTEM applies to your entire Alibaba Cloud account, while INSTANCE applies only to the current instance. The default value is INSTANCE.
parameters.description_zh: 应用范围，包括SYSTEM和INSTANCE，分别对应系统级禁止外呼和客户自定义禁止外呼，SYSTEM是关联实例所属的阿里云主账号的，INSTANCE只和当前实例关联，非必填，默认值INSTANCE。
parameters.help_en: Specifies the scope of the do-not-call numbers. A value of SYSTEM applies to your entire Alibaba Cloud account, while INSTANCE applies only to the current instance. The default value is INSTANCE
parameters.help_zh: 应用范围，包括SYSTEM和INSTANCE，分别对应系统级禁止外呼和客户自定义禁止外呼，SYSTEM是关联实例所属的阿里云主账号的，INSTANCE只和当前实例关联，非必填，默认值INSTANCE
parameters.name: scope
